footnotes.fn_f2c3866d: By the end of 2021, UNHCR reported 54,025 stateless persons in the Russian Federation. This estimation was based on the number of self-proclaimed stateless persons identified during the 2010 census (178,000), from whom the number of persons who obtained Russian citizenship throughout the reporting periods was subtracted on a yearly basis since 2011. According to the results of the 2020 All-Russia Census finalized at end 2022, some 95,193 persons declared themselves stateless and this figure was taken as a baseline for statistics on statelessness for 2022, causing an increase of 41,139 in estimated statelessness population figures for Russia compared to end-2021 (but still a decrease compared to latest Census).
